::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 20th [1865]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 73-74
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
I send a second instalment of the [Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd), I suppose about enough for another [number](organizations/other_78.qmd).

I hope I am to have the proofs, for there is a mention of Maximilian in the first chapter as grown up which I must alter.

I have done two more chapters of [Bethlehem](organizations/other_177.qmd), - that is I have written them, but I am not satisfied with the second of them.

Many thanks for the four copies of [Golden Deeds](cmy_books/cmybook_51.qmd). 

What an unusually glorious spring.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
